text: What if we treated open source funding like a controlled experiment? Instead of the usual scramble for grants, try a "micro-subscription" test for a single project. For one month, offer a low-cost, tiered membership specifically to fund a single, highly requested feature. If the community doesn't bite, you simply revert to the standard model with no long-term debt or broken promises. It’s a low-stakes way to measure true value and community willingness to pay before committing to a full pivot.
